versions.content: With each call to the function Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC the Dem module shall return the next DTC and its associated status matching the filter criteria defined by the function call of Dem_SetDTCFilter [SWS_Dem_00057].

With each call to the function Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC the Dem module shall return the next DTC and its associated status matching a set DTC filter.
